children: Slide entered into secured credit facilities totaling $1.072 billion, including a $670 million revolving facility and a $402 million delayed-draw term loan facility, and borrowed $50 million at closing. The new facilities mature in October 2031 and replace the company's prior credit agreement, which Slide repaid and terminated on October 26, 2026. The refinancing increases available revolving commitments and provides funding for general corporate purposes and permitted acquisitions; no early termination penalties applied to the old agreement.
: Secured revolving and delayed-draw term loan facilities
: The Huntington National Bank and other lenders
: Refinance existing debt and support liquidity, operations and permitted acquisitions
: Replace the existing facility with new, larger credit facilities
